//: MCP servers for the Module B Networking microhack. Works in GitHub Codespaces and local VS Code. No secrets are stored inline — credentials come from env-var/password inputs or Azure CLI / OIDC. All servers are license-free.

inputs.description: GitHub Personal Access Token (or rely on Codespaces GITHUB_TOKEN). Scopes: repo, read:org, workflow. Used by the GitHub MCP server.

azure.//: Azure MCP server (license-free, MIT). Provides resource graph, what-if/deploy, pricing, docs, best practices, Well-Architected and Bicep/Terraform AVM tooling. Authenticates with DefaultAzureCredential — run `az login` locally, or rely on the Codespaces/OIDC identity. NEVER store Azure keys here.

github.//: GitHub remote MCP server (license-free). Drives Issues for control tracking, PRs, and Actions runs. In Codespaces the built-in GITHUB_TOKEN is used automatically; locally, supply a PAT via the github-pat input.
